hook: Tanker with *27 Indians* aboard hit by limpet mines in Hormuz
hook_b: Should India escort Indian-crewed ships through Hormuz?
tldr: A tanker carrying 27 Indians was attacked with limpet mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

beats.what: NDTV reports a tanker with 27 Indians aboard was attacked with limpet mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
beats.why: It was the first successful use of limpet mines in the waterway since the conflict began in February, per NDTV.
beats.care: Hormuz carries much of the Gulf's oil, so attacks there reach fuel prices and Indian crews at sea.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: NDTV: the attack is described as the first successful deployment of limpet mines in the strategic waterway since the conflict began in February; limpet mines attach to a ship's hull and can be placed by a diver. Casualties and the owner were not in the summary.

cards.q: Should India send its navy to escort Indian-crewed ships through Hormuz?
opts: Tell crews to avoid the route

learn.t: A limpet mine is an explosive stuck to a ship's hull, usually placed by a swimmer or diver.

watch: India's MEA statement on the crew.

sources.name: NDTV
sources.title: Tanker Carrying 27 Indians Attacked With Limpet Mines In Strait Of Hormuz
